messages.text: hey, quick logistics before i head out to the venue setup. did you guys actually register for the dropbox track yet?
yeah, chen submitted the form last night. we're in the main hall, table 14 i think? feels a bit too close to the coffee station for my taste.
haha, caffeine is fuel. just check the wifi portal rules though, they're strict about bandwidth caps this year. don't want your local model inference getting throttled mid-demo.

good heads up. we're mostly running offline anyway since it's all on the gx10, but i'll grab an ethernet cable just in case the wifi chokes. also bringing a spare monitor so jane can see the atlas without squinting.
i actually have a spare dell sitting in my office. it's got a 4k display, might be better for the visual part. i'll drop it off at the registration desk before noon.
you are a lifesaver. the turquoise theme needs the pixels. thanks diego.
